title: Police Blotter: 9 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Nine people were booked into the Webb County Jail on November 18, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, assault, theft, criminal trespass and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Nine people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

David Roberto Vela Jr.

David Roberto Vela Jr. was arrested on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 3:26 p.m. on alleged charges of driving while intoxicated with an open alcohol container, a Class B misdemeanor, bond set at $3,000; resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor, bond set at $3,000; and accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor, bond set at $2,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Ronald Daley

Ronald Daley was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 3:24 a.m. on an alleged charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Gino Alberto Escamilla

Gino Alberto Escamilla was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 4:31 a.m. on an alleged charge of possession of a dangerous drug, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000. He was arrested by the Department of Public Safety.

Pedro Barrientos III

Pedro Barrientos III was booked on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 8:47 a.m. on a federal violation hold. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The holding agency was the United States Marshals Service.

Ian Avelar Neasham

Ian Avelar Neasham was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 10:52 a.m. on an alleged charge of terroristic threat causing fear of imminent serious bodily injury, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The booking record also shows an out-of-county/state hold. He was arrested by the Webb County Sheriff's Office.

Alexa Ivana Rivera Andrade

Alexa Ivana Rivera Andrade was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 1:15 p.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Nelda De-Leon

Nelda De-Leon was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 7:01 p.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property of $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,000. She was arrested by the Webb County Sheriff's Office.

Ramiro Deleon III

Ramiro Deleon III was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 7:05 p.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property of $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,000. He was arrested by the Webb County Sheriff's Office.

Aquim Obed Garcia

Aquim Obed Garcia was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 7:15 p.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property of $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.
